mapper.select: select t1.account_item_id, t1.account_item_name, t1.patient_num as cardNumber, ifnull(sum(t1.principal_amount), 0) as totalPrincipal, ifnull(sum(t1.bonus_amount), 0) as totalBonus, (ifnull(sum(t1.principal_amount), 0) - ifnull(t4.refundPrincipal, 0)) as principal, (ifnull(sum(t1.bonus_amount), 0) - ifnull(t4.refundBonus, 0)) as bonus from coupon_bill_pay_detail t1 left join (select t2.order_id, t2.id, t3.patient_number, t3.account_item_id, ifnull(t3.patient_number, t3.account_item_id) as patient_num, ifnull(sum(t3.principal_amount), 0) as refundPrincipal, ifnull(sum(t3.gift_amount), 0) as refundBonus from coupon_refund t2 inner join coupon_refund_pay t3 on t2.id = t3.refund_id where t2.order_id = #{orderId} group by t2.order_id, t3.account_item_id, t3.patient_number) t4 on t4.order_id = t1.order_id and t1.account_item_id = t4.account_item_id and t4.patient_num = ifnull(t1.patient_num, t1.account_item_id) where t1.order_id = #{orderId} group by t1.order_id, t1.account_item_id, t1.patient_num
